units.source_text: 接下来的事儿就不用多说了。

en.t: There is no need to say much about what happened next.

units.source_text: 发长彦不仅得到了很多赏赐，还成了飞鸟国大臣的女婿，

en.t: Hatsunagahiko not only received many rewards, but also became the son-in-law of a minister of Asuka.

units.source_text: 而两位武士被三只狗追赶，狼狈的跑出了大臣的府邸。

en.t: Meanwhile, the two warriors were chased by three dogs and fled from the minister's mansion in a miserable panic.

units.source_text: 不过，究竟是哪位公主嫁给了发长彦呢？

en.t: But which princess was it who married Hatsunagahiko?

units.source_text: 因为年代久远，真的无从查询了。

en.t: Because it was so long ago, there is truly no way to find out.
